title: BOS-1142 accounts failed credential check and in-place reauthentication

scenes.title: a live check that rejected the credential names the fault and the remedy

expect.label: the row an operator believes is in service carries the daemon's own verdict, not just a red health cell
the BOS-973 injection failure is still shown alongside the check verdict
the remedy for an auth_invalidated account is offered on the same screen as the diagnosis

scenes.title: never checked and checked-and-clean are different answers

steps.caption: The same list, read for what it says about the two rows nobody has diagnosed

expect.label: an account the daemon asked about, and which answered: health ok AND check ok

expect.text: personal-codex codex disabled failed never checked
expect.label: an account nobody has ever asked about reads 'never checked', never a bare 'ok' that would claim a verification that never happened (BOS-892)

scenes.title: reauthenticating in place repairs the bound row rather than adding a second one

steps.caption: Move to the disabled personal codex account
Move to the team codex account whose credential was rejected
Start in-place reauthentication for the selected account
The flow names the account whose credential is about to be replaced, and never presents the provider chooser

expect.label: the device login says which existing account it is about to overwrite, so it cannot be mistaken for the add flow
the operator is given the device-login prompt rather than a spinner with no instruction

steps.caption: The daemon verified the replacement credential and the list reports it

expect.text: the new credential verified. The account is eligible again.
expect.label: success is reported only after the daemon's post-save verification returned a verdict, never on a save that merely did not error (BOS-943)
the SAME row recovered: the identity, label and priority the sessions are bound to are unchanged and its health is ok again
